title: ResponsiveGrid
description: An equal-column grid whose column count follows its own width (container queries), not the viewport.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Spans the full row of the surrounding grid

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges the item props, classes and ref into its single child instead of rendering a wrapper div

props.name: as
props.description: Element or component rendered as the outer container (div, section, nav...)

props.name: columns
props.description: Column counts, responding to the grid's own width (container queries): a number, or `{ base, sm, md, lg }` (480 / 768 / 1200px). Integers 1-12; other values throw a RangeError.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between rows and columns: numbers and numeric strings select spacing tokens, other strings are CSS values

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: columns="1 2 3 4" sets the column count for the base, sm, md and lg container widths; the grid follows its own width, not the viewport.

container.title: Container breakpoints
container.description: columns also accepts JSON ({"base": 1, "sm": 2, "lg": 4}; missing breakpoints inherit the previous one) and row-gap / column-gap split the gap. Drag the slider to resize the container.

full-width.title: Full-width items
full-width.description: Wrap a child in <minerva-grid-item full-width> to span the whole row.
